svg.title: How hidebox works
svg.desc: Your browser locks each file before upload. Our server stores only scrambled noise and the file's rule. Whoever has the link opens it by that rule, with the key that hides in the link after the # sign. On the Tari Ootle testnet: Send by Tari, Pay to open, and a public receipt when a file leaves your drive.
